facts.name: Sherwood Bauer, Jr.
facts.assignment: Martin circuit judge; profile supplies civil, probate and guardianship office procedures. Full current division allocation remains for county assignment reconciliation.

contact.contact_note: Email is primary; office phone supplied when email contact is impossible. Separate probate/guardianship submission inboxes; no personal judge email inferred.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant with case number/name and matter in subject; copy all parties. Do not include assistant in counsel’s coordination exchanges.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion first. Email assistant for non-UMC hearing dates, coordinate with all parties, and send motion, Word order and notice within five working days of tentative date. Online scheduling is only for non-evidentiary UMC of ten minutes or less.

conferral.summary: Profile requires applicable Rule1.202 conferral certification or statement that conferral is not required; link retained for exact wording.

proposed_orders.summary: Word orders by assistant email, probate to ProbateMC; filename identifies case and order. Cover letter states agreement/disagreement. Profile calls for submission within two days after hearing.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email case law/materials to assistant and copy parties. Courtesy section says two days before hearing; scheduling section separately says brief memoranda at least five days before hearing. Keep document-specific statements.

remote_appearances.summary: Do not assume Zoom permission. File motion and email copy at scheduling or at least120hours before hearing; email alone is insufficient. Profile distinguishes short non-evidentiary hearings from other appearances; consult linked instructions and resulting order.

case_management.summary: Parties request civil CMC by assistant email to obtain specific trial dates; profile explains that desired CMPO trial month alone does not set a trial.

facts.summary: Assistant/contact routes and practical scheduling, order, courtesy and remote instructions reviewed from full official HTML. Specialty probate/guardianship review limited to submission inboxes; linked forms/calendars not analyzed.
